description: Today's pump.fun weather (refreshed hourly): launches per hour, share of launches prepared in advance (3+ buyers in the launch block), share of creators dumping within 5 minutes, migrations, share of winning positions, which entry speed made money in the last 24 h (launch block / 1-10 s / 10 s-5 min / later), and serial launch teams of the last 7 days. Use it before tuning a bot or when someone asks what is happening on pump.fun now. Past facts, not a forecast.
name: botsharper_pump_weather
